## New
- Picture-in-picture: a Listen in background button switches the video to audio and closes the window (#1523)
- Post images: pinch or double-tap to zoom, and swipe between the images of a post

## Improved
- Picture-in-picture: going home slides the video itself into the window, and on Android 15 the controls hide first (#1523)
- Lyrics: the Translation switch says when a song's lyrics have no translation (#1524)

## Fixed
- TV: the navigation rail opens and works with the remote in right-to-left languages such as Arabic (#1602)
- TV: pressing OK on a search field shows the keyboard again (#1602)
- Post images open whole at their real shape instead of YouTube's square crop (#1585)
- Home: videos you scroll past are counted, and ones you pass again later stay off Home for a few days (#1565)
- Music: tapping the artists of a song from history, liked songs or a playlist offers every artist again
